_source: UAPTS Role-Based Access Control Specification (Greenworld Big Data Limited) - see Reference.md section 9 for the resolver this file feeds.

aviation.label: Aviation
aviation.note: Not bound to any agency's domains list - KAA and KCAA (added 2026-09-18 to match the RBAC test seed) are granted M07a directly instead, since neither has a real assessment return confirming full domain membership is appropriate. Revisit once KCAA's assessment lands.

oversight.label: Ministry Oversight
oversight.note: Read scope, not a module bundle in the ordinary sense - grants cross-agency visibility with no write right anywhere. Actual breadth per tenant is narrowed by that agency's own grants.read/grants.routes below (section 9 open decision: SDR-R's oversight breadth is currently roads-domain only, not this full list).

M10.label: Access Control
M10.note: Every agency's grants.full now includes M10 (added 2026-09-19) - every agency admin manages its own tenant's users/roles/audit, same as KMA already did (its own note here predates the rollout and assumed every other agency already had this; they didn't - only KMA and, via the 'oversight' domain, SDR/SDT had any M10 access at all, so every other agency's admins could not open Access Control). /agencies stays separately gated (minTier 'oversight' + page-level isUnscopedAdmin write check) since it's the platform-wide agency directory, not a tenant's own data - see its own route note.

/query-builder.note: Gap #2 - raw SQL bypasses route control. Restricted to Ministry Oversight and Super Admin until row-level DB security exists. See section 9.4.

/agencies.note: The agency directory itself (tbl_agencies), not any one tenant's data - restricted to Ministry Oversight and Super Admin, same pattern as /query-builder. minTierDomainOverride additionally admits admin-tier accounts at SDT/SDR (the 'oversight' domain) since no seeded account anywhere carries the literal role_type 'oversight' - see useAccessControl.ts step 7. Write (create/edit/delete) is further narrowed to super_admin only in the page itself, since 'oversight' is documented read-only (roles.oversight.write:false) and this resolver doesn't enforce that flag.

/admin/dashboards.note: Dashboard Manager. Route-level gate only; the page and middleware/dashboard-manager.global.ts additionally require dashboards.manage or dashboards.manage_agency, and the API enforces the same.

/admin/dashboards/[id].note: Dashboard Manager editor - same gate as /admin/dashboards.

/access-policies.note: Module Access - what each agency and role may reach. super_admin edits every agency's ceiling; an agency admin edits only its own agency within that ceiling (see docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-28-module-access-control-design.md).

/gis.note: Category filtering here is layer-level, not route-level - see section 6.

denies.note: land_parcel and resettlement are NOT denied here - KeNHA's own tenant may see its own records (section 4.1: 'not visible outside KeNHA' means outsiders, not KeNHA itself). Those two are denied on the cross-agency viewer side instead (see SDR-R). crash_victim and anpr_plate are genuine platform-wide blocks (ingestion refusal / feature flag off) that apply to every viewer including KeNHA.

critical_infrastructure and procurement are KURA's own categories - restricted to KURA's own Agency Admin tier (see restrictedCategories.minTier), not denied to KURA's tenant outright, so they are not listed here.
procurement and high_res_geometry are KeRRA's own categories - Agency Admin tier within KeRRA (restrictedCategories.minTier), not denied to KeRRA's tenant outright.

SDR.name: State Department for Roads - Roads Directorate

denies.note: Write access to any agency's operational records is denied outright regardless of the route-level 'full' grants above - oversight role's write:false covers this; grants here are read/consolidation only per section 4.4. Key renamed from 'SDR-R' to 'SDR' 2026-09-18 to match tbl_agencies.agency_code from the RBAC test seed - the hyphenated key silently failed to resolve for every seeded sdr.* account (agency_code.toUpperCase() never matched 'SDR-R'). roleTiers still lists only oversight/analyst per the original spec, but the seed also created sdr.admin and sdr.operator accounts with no spec definition for what those tiers should see here - flagged, not resolved by this rename; they currently inherit whatever grants/denies apply at their tier via the normal resolver, which may not reflect real intent.

SDR_MTD.name: State Department for Roads - Mechanical and Transport Directorate

denies.note: lease_commercial is SDR_MTD's own category - Agency Admin tier within SDR_MTD (restrictedCategories.minTier), not denied to its own tenant outright. Key renamed from 'SDR-MTD' to 'SDR_MTD' 2026-09-18 to match tbl_agencies.agency_code from the RBAC test seed.

Provisional - added 2026-09-18 so the tbl_agencies.agency_code seeded for the RBAC test accounts resolves to a tenant at all; no UAPTS Needs Assessment return exists for this agency and none of the grants below are spec'd. Devolved units' real mandate (local roads, matatu SACCO licensing) suggests read access to traffic plus its own reporting; public-transport is a single route-level read (the overview only, not driver-licensing/vehicle-registration PII sub-routes - those stay denied by default the same way KURA and NAMATA deny them to everyone but the owning tenant). Confirm before treating as real policy.

Provisional - added 2026-09-18, no assessment return on file. The 'aviation' domain block already notes KAA/KCAA are the intended aviation tenants but were unassigned pending a return; this grants KAA its own module directly rather than binding it to that domain bundle. Confirm before treating as real policy.

Provisional - added 2026-09-18, no assessment return on file (this is the agency the 'aviation' domain note names explicitly as not having returned one). As the aviation safety regulator, read access to Safety and Incidents is included alongside its own module; crash_victim stays denied the same way it does platform-wide for KeNHA/NTSA/NPS - KCAA does not own that data. Confirm before treating as real policy.

Provisional - added 2026-09-18, no assessment return on file. KMD is a cross-cutting weather-data provider rather than a domain member; scoped to reporting plus read access to GIS and traffic alerts rather than any operational module. Confirm before treating as real policy.

Provisional - added 2026-09-18, no assessment return on file. KRA's customs mandate suggests read access to imports/exports specifically, not the whole Maritime module - a single route-level grant, same pattern as KRC/NCTTCA reading into KPA's module. cargo_commercial is denied cross-tenant the same way it is for KRC reading KPA's routes, since KRA is not KPA's own tenant. Confirm before treating as real policy.

Provisional - added 2026-09-18, no assessment return on file. KRB coordinates road-maintenance funding across KeNHA/KURA/KeRRA, so it lands on the funding view with a full Road Infrastructure grant; procurement stays visible since restrictedCategories.procurement's minTier (admin) is met by KRB's own admin tier, matching how that category behaves for KeNHA/KURA/KeRRA's own admins. Confirm before treating as real policy.

Provisional - added 2026-09-18, no assessment return on file. KenTrade runs the national single-window trade platform, so it is scoped to Data Integration Hub plus a single route-level read into port operations, not the whole Maritime module. Confirm before treating as real policy.

Provisional - added 2026-09-18, no assessment return on file. crash_victim stays denied the same way it does platform-wide for KeNHA - genuine ingestion-level restriction, not specific to NPS. Confirm before treating as real policy.

Provisional - added 2026-09-18, no assessment return on file. Scoped to GIS (conservancy/wildlife-corridor road mapping) plus read access to Safety and Incidents (wildlife-vehicle collisions); crash_victim stays denied the same way it does platform-wide for KeNHA/NTSA/NPS/KCAA - KWS does not own that data. Confirm before treating as real policy.

Provisional - added 2026-09-18, no assessment return on file. SDT is the parent ministry of SDR/SDR_MTD, so it mirrors SDR's Ministry Oversight domain and sensitive-category denials; unlike SDR it was seeded with admin/analyst/operator/oversight-named accounts rather than just oversight/analyst, and (like SDR) none of those rows actually carry role_type='oversight' in the seed - the sdt.oversight and sdr.oversight accounts are role_type='admin', so the oversight tier this entry lists is currently unreachable by any seeded login. Confirm before treating as real policy.
vehicle_owner_pii is NTSA's own category - Agency Admin tier within NTSA (restrictedCategories.minTier), not denied to its own tenant outright.
driver_conductor_pii is pseudonymised at ingest (a backend transform, not a route mask) - the raw value never exists in the platform, so there is nothing for the client resolver to deny.

passenger_pii is blocked at ingestion platform-wide (only station-pair/class/date aggregates ever enter the platform), so there is nothing to deny client-side. cargo_commercial IS denied here - KRC reads KPA's port-ops/imports-exports/cargo routes read-only and KPA's masked commercial cargo fields must not surface through that cross-agency read.

cargo_commercial is KPA's own category - Agency Admin tier within KPA (restrictedCategories.minTier), not denied to its own tenant outright. It IS denied on the reading side for other agencies (see KRC).

M10 grant here is strictly the KMA tenant's own users/roles/audit, same as any other Agency Admin - not a platform-wide grant. The resolver's agency scope on M10 already confines it; no special-case needed. vessel_owner_pii is KMA's own category - Agency Admin tier within KMA (restrictedCategories.minTier), not denied to its own tenant outright.

NCTTCA.name: Northern Corridor Transit and Transport Coordination Authority

denies.note: Member state data cannot be re-shared onward, exported, or surfaced on the public view without the governing NDA/MoU permitting it - enforced at export/query level, not route level. Only aggregates ingested until the member-state-council question in section 9 is settled.
Provisional - sections 1, 3, 4, 6 and 7 of the LAPSSET assessment return were blank, so no approval chain or sensitivity position was recorded. Confirm before activating this tenant (section 9).

publicView.note: Every category is denied on the public view by construction (section 2.6: no agency-attributed figure below the national aggregate, no personal data without exception). This list exists so a category added to section 6 later is deny-by-default here too, not to enumerate an allow-list.

land_parcel.label: Parcel-level land acquisition; resettlement and grievance records

critical_infrastructure.label: Critical infrastructure GIS layers; security-related infrastructure information

procurement.label: Procurement, tender, contractor pricing, bid evaluation, claims and dispute records

high_res_geometry.label: High-resolution road maps with precise coordinates; bridge and structural coordinates; collapse-prone segments

passenger_pii.label: Passenger ticketing records - name, ID number, gender, phone, nationality

cargo_commercial.label: Consignee identity, shipper, notify party, commercial cargo values

vehicle_owner_pii.label: Vehicle owner personal details; driving licence lifecycle records

member_state_data.label: Member state customs and border data

lease_commercial.label: Lease programme commercial terms and applicant details
